description: Measure the paired re-draw noise on the current base directly, without changing any math. On the tip (E047, or I061's successor if it is kept), make one change: in prepare(), right after seeding the trial generator and before the epoch permutations and augmentation draws, consume one dummy draw from that same trial-seeded generator (e.g. torch.randn(1, generator=g, device=g.device)). Every permutation, flip, translate and jitter value then shifts while the recipe stays identical. Nothing else changes, so no new compiled shapes are needed. Report per-seed accuracies next to the tip's. Discard the run regardless of outcome: keeping a lucky RNG shift would select on seeds 0-2 and would not transfer to the 40-seed judge.
